Cult Map of Catacombs Level 1:  "The map shows a dragon at its northern edge, and a group of eyes in the southeast corner.  Five exits are noted--two up and three down."
It reads:  "Lt. Garesh:  The Mistress grows impatient with your efforts to eliminate the orog raiders.  We cannot afford another 'incident'--for your sake.  --Overseer Sinod"
It reads:  "Lover, do not despair.  There is a secret door ... open and ... to the right.  Meet us by the fountain.  Come as soon as ... Yours forever ..."
It reads:  "Ozbort:  Lady Mordrayn craves more space.  Clear the entire floor.  --Suo"

It reads:  "Overseer Sinod:  The Mistress sends you the head of Overseer Fanret, and hopes you are more up to the task of eliminating those pitiful mercenaries than he was in dealing with the fire witches.  -- Grand Overseer Vidorus"
It reads:  "Rolf:  Patrols caughts one of them orog raiders this morning--took him down for torturing.  Keep your eyes open, there may be others lurking about.  --Theeb"

Orog Map of Catacombs Level 1:  "The map is scrawled with a group of figures in the southeast corner.  An arrow drawn to the northeast corner points toward a single figure there.  The northern edge displays a horned lizard, while the southeastern corner shows a web."
Iron Slip with Engraving of Barley
It reads:  "Overseer Sinod:  We have captured the old healer and the woman as ordered.  The troops are in position, and we will soon apprehend the mercenaries as well.  --Brigadier Helmhorn
Cult Map of Catacombs Level 4:  "The map shows a dragon in the northern corner, and a region with many eyes streching east to west just south of center.  Two exits are noted--one up and one down."

Drow Map of Catacombs Level 1:  "The map shows a serpent at its northern edge, and a spider in the southeast corner--a prison-like area appears in the center.  Five exits are noted--two up and three down."

Orog Map of Catacombs Level 2:  "The map shows some sort of fire in the center, and a bridge in the southeast corner--the northern part of the map displays a horned lizard.  Four exits are noted--three up and one down."

Drow Map of Catacombs Level 4:  "The map shows a serpent coiled about a star in the northern corner, and a region with many spiders streching east to west just south of center.  Two exits are noted--one up and one down."

Cult Map of The Passage:  "The map shows a dragon in the north-central region, a collapsed dead-end to the far east, and pair of chasms in the far west area--one of which seems to be another dead-end.  Two exits are noted--one leading up at each end."

It reads:  "Archmage Setharr:  Continue to interrogate our Orog friend until he tells us the location of the Rogue Orog Band--no matter how much he howls!  Consider it imperative that I get this information and find these raiders, before they find you!  --Lt. Garesh"
It reads:  "Lt. Garesh:  Unless I get more men, and the mages silence the screaming of that so-called prisoner of theirs, this whole orog raider hunt is just going to cost us..."

It reads:  "Borgin:  The gargoyle guano is starting to pile up again on the old broken walkway to the east.  We had another 'slip and fall' accident the other day--young soldier, fell and landed near the arracats.  Try to retrieve the body before it starts to smell.  --Quartermaster Falon"

It reads:  "Grand Overseer Vidorus:  I require a replacement for Archmage Tudor.  He had hoped to increase the capacity of the Soul Vessel with his latest formula, but botched the incantation.  Alas, there appears to have been room for at least one more soul in the Vessel.  --Overseer Glothaust"

Last entry:  "The Traprunes are in place, but the labyrinthine nature of these accursed dungeons is maddening.  There seem to be an unusual amount of the large spider-creatures down here.  I've found some old elven wine which is quite refreshing... relaxing... must rest... yes, quite..."

It reads:  "Lt. Grudy:  I am under some pressure to see to it that the surviving fire witches are brought before Lady Mordrayn.  Get off your lazy rump and find the witches by dawn, or I personally will cut off your bulbous nose.  --Brigadier Helmhorn

It reads:  "Lt. Calwort:  I hereby request reassignment to guard the storage rooms.  It is too far to the latrine from my current post, given the quality of the rations we have been given, and I am not about to drop my pants out there with them ghouls shambling about.  --Filbert"

It reads:  "Galibel:  As you may not know, we lost last night's watch at this post.  Something big came through and tore up four bloodless drow and took off with a mage's body before reinforcements could arrive.  Thanks for switching duty with us tonight.  Good luck.  --Lt. Jurck
It reads:  "...just remember the proper components... no, wait... yes!  ...my head... my aching head..."
It reads:  "...the stuff of life... reborn... why won't it... another corpse..."
It reads:  "...one more time... It moved!  ...decomposition... so little time..."
It reads:  "...must be done... any means... Myth Drannor... will live... dead...again..."

It reads:  "Grand Overseer Vidorus:  I wish you to reconsider our vulnerability to the House of Freth.  With the Kilsek Drow now out of the way, it is only a matter of time before the Freth challenge our control of the catacombs.  We must eliminate them as well to insure that the Lady's endeavors go as planned.  --Overseer Morgaan

It reads:  "Lt. Torin:  I understand your men's concern over the orders, but I have my own as well.  The sickly old elf is to remain under heavy guard until I am told otherwise.  It may not feel like it, but I assure you it is important and your men are most vital to the Mistress' plans for him.  --Brigadier Norwarden"

It reads:  "Brigadier Norwarden:  Field Marshall Thraun is calling your unit in to strengthen defenses at the castle.  I don't believe we have anything to fear from this band of mercenaries myself, but one can never be too cautious.  I'll see you on the ramparts.  --Brigadier Llor"
Gemstones & Jewels (very high quality and value)
It reads: "Higbin: The ceremony ended too soon. The man's name is Faldis. Wait a fortnight, then take what he no longer needs. And do not fail to give me my share. -K"

It reads: "Garras: If you have survived somehow, know that I have hidden your spare arms in the space beyond our trysting room. I go now to the Elven Court - seek me there! I will wait for you always. -Elena"

It reads: "Lord: I quake to trouble you with so small a matter, but foul Lizardfolk have crept down into our midst, and compete with our orogs for magical treasure. If I could have but one squad of - "
It reads: "Torathel: Lizardfolk have been seen in the area around the Nightmare Gate. You'd best take the weapon I stuck in the bookcase just upstairs. -Azmark"
It reads: "Lady: I crave kind permission to dispel your Nightmare Gate, as it has done its duty. The undead hordes were most effective at repulsing orcs, but now they - "
It reads:  "Drake: I pray you can claim our keepsake. I hid it where we so often sat to play at chess. -Durlin."
It reads: "You have done well to report what you found. Overseer Fanraet is sure the correct Word of Power will release the ring. Investigate this. We will make inquiries of our own."
It reads: "Overseer Fanraet: We have examined every word in this room and none is the word we seek.  I await your further instructions --Iolrak."
